name: Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind
ability: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; that target's ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF.

name: Blackwing - Bora the Spear
ability: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Bora the Spear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Blackwing - Blizzard the Far North
ability: Cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "Blackwing" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position.

name: Blackwing - Shura the Blue Flame
ability: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Blackwing" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, but its effects are negated.

name: Blackwing - Elphin the Raven
ability: If you control a "Blackwing" monster, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.

name: Blackwing - Mistral the Silver Shield
ability: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Reduce the next battle damage you would take this turn to 0.

name: Blackwing - Fane the Steel Chain
ability: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Target 1 Attack Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to Defense Position.

name: Blackwing - Ghibli the Searing Wind
ability: When your opponent declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Once per turn: You can switch the original ATK and DEF of this card, until the end of this turn.

name: Blackwing - Gust the Backblast
ability: If you control no cards, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If your opponent's monster attacks a "Blackwing" monster you control, the attacking monster loses 300 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: Blackwing - Kochi the Daybreak
ability: If this card was Special Summoned, it cannot be used as a Synchro Material.

name: Blackwing - Jetstream the Blue Sky
ability: During damage calculation, you can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard to prevent a "Blackwing" monster you control from being destroyed by this battle.

name: Blackwing - Zephyros the Elite
ability: If this card is in your GY: You can return 1 face-up card you control to the hand; Special Summon this card, and if you do, take 400 damage. You can only use this effect of "Blackwing - Zephyros the Elite" once per Duel.

name: Blackwing Armor Master
ability:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle, and you take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a monster: You can place 1 Wedge Counter on that monster (max. 1). You can remove all Wedge Counters from your opponent's monsters; the ATK and DEF of those monsters that had Wedge Counters become 0 until the end of this turn.

name: Blackwing Armed Wing
ability:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only, also inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Blackwing - Silverwind the Ascendant
ability:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 2 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field with DEF lower than this card's ATK; destroy those targets. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. During each of your opponent's turns, the first "Blackwing" monster you control that would be destroyed by battle, is not destroyed.

name: Black-Winged Dragon
ability:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If you would take damage from a card effect, place 1 Black Feather Counter on this card instead. This card loses 700 ATK for each Black Feather Counter on it. Once per turn: You can remove all Black Feather Counters on this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; that target loses 700 ATK for each Black Feather Counter you removed, and if it does, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK lost by this effect.

name: Raptor Wing Strike
ability: Shuffle 1 "Blackwing" monster you control into the Main Deck; add 1 "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Against the Wind
ability: Select 1 "Blackwing" monster in your Graveyard. Take damage equal to the ATK of the selected monster, and add it to your hand.

name: Black-Winged Strafe
ability: Send 1 "Blackwing" monster from your hand to the Graveyard to select 1 Defense Position monster your opponent controls. Send that monster to the Graveyard.

name: Cards for Black Feathers
ability: Banish 1 "Blackwing" monster from your hand; draw 2 cards. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card. You can only activate 1 "Cards for Black Feathers" per turn.

name: Ebon Arrow
ability: Select 1 face-up monster you control. Until the End Phase, it loses 500 ATK and during battle between that attacking monster and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the selected monster's ATK, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. When the selected monster destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard this turn, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the destroyed monster's original DEF.

name: Delta Crow - Anti Reverse
ability: If you control a "Blackwing" monster: Destroy all face-down Spells and Traps your opponent controls. If you control exactly 3 "Blackwing" monsters, you can activate this card from your hand.

name: Level Retuner
ability: Reduce the Level of 1 face-up monster you control by up to 2.

name: Fake Feather
ability: Send 1 "Blackwing" monster from your hand to the Graveyard and select 1 Normal Trap Card in your opponent's Graveyard. The effect of this card will be same as the selected Normal Trap Card.

name: Blackwing - Backlash
ability: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while you have 5 or more "Blackwing" monsters in your Graveyard: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

name: Blackwing - Bombardment
ability: Tribute 1 "Blackwing" monster to select 1 face-up Synchro Monster you control. That Synchro Monster gains ATK equal to the Tributed monster's ATK, until the End Phase.

name: Black Thunder
ability: Activate only when a "Blackwing" monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard. Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card your opponent controls.

name: Guard Mines
ability: Activate only when a card is activated with an effect that would target and destroy 1 monster you control. Negate the effect and destroy that card. Then inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Black Feather Beacon
ability: Activate only when you take damage from a card effect. Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Blackwing" monster from your hand.

name: Black Return
ability: When exactly 1 "Blackwing" monster (and no other monster) is Special Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; gain LP equal to the ATK of that target, and if you do, return it to the hand.
